notes.title: Gamepad support comes to Algae!
notes.notes:
We're excited to announce that Algae now has Gamepad support! You can now use your favourite gamepads to clone and solve puzzle just as well as using a mouse and keyboard!

In addition, we've also now released Algae to Linux, meaning you can now play it on your favourite Linux distro, or on the go on a SteamDeck!
